question:
The pie chart shows the percentage of students studying in different courses in a college. The degree measure of angle for students studying in BBA is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f639d08cbd2afc2aebb472f7a2314e274ff1b7da56163d908765459921fce2cd.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

BBA = 8%

The degree measure of angle for students studying in BBA :

⇒ 8% × 360

⇒ 8/100 × 360

⇒ 0.08 × 360 = 28.8°

**∴ The degree measure of angle is 28.8°**
